svg.title: Napa & Sonoma (CA) study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Napa Valley; 2: Sonoma; 3: Yountville; 4: Saint Helena; 5: Calistoga; 6: Angwin; 7: Kenwood; 8: Lake County; 9: Solano County; 10: Santa Rosa; 11: Vallejo

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
